# Akamai (Linode) — Akamai Cloud Rise Start-Up Program

Up to $120,000 in Akamai Cloud credits in year one of a three-year program, with discounts rather than credits in years two and three.

## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | $120,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Page states first-year credits do not roll over month to month or to subsequent years. |
| **When it ends** | Rise is a three-year program with discounts offered in years two and three. |

- Existing Akamai customers
- Resellers
- MSPs
- Systems integrators

### Notes

Age cap quoted as "established businesses fewer than seven years old". Exclusion quoted as "Sorry, existing customers are not eligible for Rise." Account requirement quoted as "You must create a new account for your start-up with 1) the corporate email address associated with your company domain, and 2) a valid credit card." The page lists traction signals (paid employees outside founders, non-friends-and-family users, initial revenue, or VC funding) as qualifying signals, so VC funding is not stated as mandatory; funding_required left unknown. The intake form is embedded on the same URL, so no separate apply URL exists. A discovery call is described as a process step but is not stated as a requirement, so requires_sales_call is left unknown. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
